items.text:
Subject: Research paper draft - Munich conference travel

Hi Priya,

I've attached the near-final draft of the sustainable-mobility paper ahead of the Munich conference. Could you look at the travel budget section on page 4 and tell me whether the numbers still line up with the quotes you collected in March?

A few logistics notes in case they help. Our automated booking tool flagged a cheaper Lufthansa routing via Frankfurt, but I want your view before we lock anything in. The conference organisers have also asked everyone to arrive by Sunday evening for the welcome session, so any itinerary that lands after 17:00 on Sunday is probably too tight.

Finally, the reimbursement office wants the bookings done through the usual portal rather than by phone. Let me know what you think and we can finalise on Thursday.

Best,
Marcus

intent.requested_action: review the travel budget and advise on booking

items.text:
Subject: Year 9 school trip to Edinburgh - booking query

Hello TravelDesk,

I'm the trip coordinator for the Year 9 history trip to Edinburgh from 3-6 June, and I'm trying to sort out the coach and hostel bookings before term ends.

Our assistant tool has already suggested a couple of options, but I'd like a human to check the details. There are 38 pupils and 4 staff, so we need two coaches with a split that keeps the same staff-to-pupil ratio we had last year. The hostel has confirmed 10 rooms; the maths works out fine but I want the bed allocation checked before we pay the deposit.

The deputy head has asked that any booking confirmation come to my school address rather than the shared office inbox. Could you reply with the itinerary and the payment deadline?

Thanks,
Helen Okonjo
Fenwick Comprehensive

intent.requested_action: check coach and hostel booking details

Subject: Charity cycle tour - final itinerary

Hi Sam,

The Rio to Brighton charity cycle is nearly ready. Our trip assistant compiled the route notes and booked the overnight stops, and everything looked good when I checked it on Monday.

One thing to flag: the Brighton hotel has moved us to the annexe because of a conference. Same rate, but the bikes will need to go in the garage instead of the room. Could you update the event page so riders know to bring their own locks?

The sponsor logos have to be with the printer by Friday, so if any rider names are still missing, send them over today.

Thanks,
Rob
